metadata.summary: Brydon Carse will not face any charges after Derbyshire Police closed their investigation into an alleged assault following an incident involving the England cricketer at a nightclub in Derby.
metadata.content: Brydon Carse: No charges against England cricketer after police close investigation into alleged assault at nightclub | Cricket News | Sky Sports Skip to main content Breaking Brydon Carse: No charges against England cricketer after police close investigation into alleged assault at nightclub Derbyshire Police have ended their investigation into an alleged assault incident which involved England and Durham cricketer Brydon Carse; Carse, who has played for Durham in the County Championship during the investigation over the last month, will not face any charges Friday 18 September 2026 18:06, UK Image: Brydon Carse will not face any charges after an investigation Brydon Carse will not face any charges after Derbyshire Police closed their investigation into an alleged assault following an incident involving the England cricketer at a nightclub in Derby. Last month, Carse was handcuffed outside a nightclub in Derby and missed the second and third Tests of England's series against Pakistan. The 31-year-old was celebrating with Durham players after their win at Derbyshire in the County Championship and was also seen talking to team-mate Matthew Potts with former England captain Ben Stokes also pictured in the background. messages.text: Somerset title hopes suffer major blow in Yorkshire defeat as Notts also lose

metadata.summary: Somerset's hopes of becoming county champions for the first time in their history took a major blow as they collapsed to a costly defeat at the hands of Yorkshire.
metadata.content: County Championship: Somerset's title hopes hit badly in Yorkshire defeat as Notts also miss out to leave Warwickshire in command | Cricket News | Sky Sports Skip to main content County Championship: Somerset's title hopes hit badly in Yorkshire defeat as Notts also miss out to leave Warwickshire in command Somerset lose leadership of Division One to Warwickshire heading into the final round of matches after hugely-costly 185-run defeat to Yorkshire at Headingley; Somerset at home to Surrey, while Warwickshire host Leicestershire in final title-deciding matches from September 24 Friday 18 September 2026 14:39, UK Image: Yorkshire players congratulate Adam Lyth (l) for taking a catch from the bowling of Ben Coad to dismiss Somerset's James Rew (SWpix.com) Somerset's hopes of becoming county champions for the first time in their history took a major blow as they collapsed to a costly defeat at the hands of Yorkshire. Top of the County Championship Division One table heading into the penultimate round of matches, Somerset saw rivals Warwickshire wrap up a two-day victory against Essex but failed to keep pace at Headingley. Chasing 287 - the highest score of the match - they were bundled out for 101 on the final day. Resuming on 73-3 they collapsed horribly as their final seven wickets fell for 25 runs in less than 13 overs. metadata.content: Why Jurgen Klopp's 'one of 83 million' cap was significant as he named two Germany squads | Football News | Sky Sports Skip to main content Analysis Why Jurgen Klopp's 'one of 83 million' cap was significant as he named two Germany squads Ahead of Germany's four matches against Netherlands, Serbia and Greece (two), Jurgen Klopp has called up 44 players in two different groups; "We need to rediscover the fun in all of this," said Klopp as he announced the squads By Sebastian Stafford-Bloor, The Athletic Friday 18 September 2026 12:58, UK Image: Jurgen Klopp has called up 44 players in two different groups ahead of Germany facing Netherlands, Serbia and Greece Jurgen Klopp has named two separate Germany squads for the upcoming Nations League matches in his first act as head coach. Ahead of the four matches against Netherlands, Serbia and Greece (two), Klopp has called up 44 players in two different groups. That list comprises 16 players who have yet to make an international appearance for Germany, including Said El Mala of Cologne, Max Rosenfelder, Philipp Treu and Derry Scherhant from Freiburg and Celtic midfielder Mika Baur. Other notable decisions include the omission of Stuttgart forward Deniz Undav, explained by Klopp as fitness-related, and his announcement that captain Joshua Kimmich will be used as a midfielder, having previously been utilised as a right-back by Julian Nagelsmann. metadata.summary: Michael Carrick insists Manchester United's recent struggles are "not a catastrophe or a disaster" and dismissed talk of pressure on his position as "ridiculous".
metadata.content: Man Utd: Michael Carrick dismisses ‘ridiculous’ speculation over his future | Football News | Sky Sports Skip to main content Man Utd: Michael Carrick dismisses ‘ridiculous’ speculation over his future Manchester United boss Michael Carrick says talk of his future is “not on his radar” and insists their recent setbacks are far from a “catastrophe”; watch Fulham vs Man Utd on Sunday, live on Sky Sports Premier League from 4pm; kick-off 4.30pm Friday 18 September 2026 16:22, UK Please use Chrome browser for a more accessible video player Manchester Utd head coach Michael Carrick dismisses questions about his future at the club saying it is not even in his thinking Michael Carrick insists Manchester United's recent struggles are "not a catastrophe or a disaster" and dismissed talk of pressure on his position as "ridiculous". Days after a controversial 1-0 home defeat by rivals Manchester City, United surrendered a two-goal lead to crash out of the Carabao Cup with a 3-2 loss to Brighton at Old Trafford, as boos rang out from the Stretford End while Carrick and his players trudged off the pitch. With just four points from their opening four Premier League games, United need a win at Fulham on Sunday to avoid heading into the international break under mounting pressure, with the familiar feeling that another season could already be slipping away.
